name: USSF-627
destination_explanation: It starts around 160 km up and runs to about 2,000 km. At this height a satellite goes all the way around the planet in about an hour and a half.
slot_a_text: B1103 typically goes 30 days between flights, with a best of 26. On that form it should fly again around mid December.
slot_b_text: It has already slipped five times. The current time was set in the last few hours and has held since. There is a 4-hour window to work with.

lg_slot_c_text: SpaceX's 126th launch of the year, 745th all time. That is a launch every other day. No Falcon 9 has failed in 347 flights. It is the 262nd orbital launch attempt worldwide this year.
description: A classified mission for the United States Space Force. It is possibly a batch of classified LEO satellites based on SpaceX’s Starshield satellite bus, based on locations of rocket stage drop zones being exact fits with previous Starlink Group 15 launches.
rocket_fact: Ion thrusters can produce only about as much thrust as the weight of a sheet of paper, but can run continuously for months or years.
